# Anthropic University

> An open, **unofficial** learning hub for Claude, created by Patrick King. It provides original
> prep for all four Claude Certification exams (Associate, Developer, Architect Foundations,
> Architect Professional) mapped to the official exam guides, plus thirteen learning lanes for
> using, building with, administering, and partnering on Claude. It includes an interactive web app
> and the cross-surface Anthropic University plugin. All content is original, teaches publicly
> documented concepts, and is **not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic**. It does not
> reproduce real or practice exam content, Academy course text, or partner-portal training.

This file follows the llmstxt.org convention to help language models navigate the repository.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, tracks, lanes, the plugin, and how to study
- [Repo guide](CLAUDE.md): canonical JSON → generated markdown, web app, and plugin data
- [Content schema](content/SCHEMA.md): tracks, lanes, and multiple-response (select-N) items
- [Verified facts snapshot](content/FACTS.md): models, surfaces, and certification program facts
- [Contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): authoring quality bar

## Certification tracks

- [Associate – Foundations study guide](content/associate-foundations/study-guide.md): prompting, output evaluation, product and model selection, workflow design, configuration, governance, troubleshooting
- [Associate – Foundations practice exam](content/associate-foundations/practice-exam.md): 121 original questions with explanations
- [Developer – Foundations study guide](content/developer-foundations/study-guide.md): agents and workflows, applications and integration, Claude Code, evals, model selection, prompt and context engineering, security, tools and MCP
- [Developer – Foundations practice exam](content/developer-foundations/practice-exam.md): 129 original questions with explanations
- [Architect – Foundations study guide](content/architect-foundations/study-guide.md): agentic architecture, tool design and MCP, Claude Code configuration, prompts and structured output, context and reliability; six scenarios
- [Architect – Foundations practice exam](content/architect-foundations/practice-exam.md): 117 original questions with explanations
- [Architect – Professional study guide](content/architect-professional/study-guide.md): solution design, models and context, integration, evaluation, governance and safety, stakeholder lifecycle, developer productivity
- [Architect – Professional practice exam](content/architect-professional/practice-exam.md): 125 original questions with explanations

## Learning lanes: Use Claude

- [Claude Essentials](content/lanes/claude-essentials/lane.md): Use Claude well in the apps: write clear prompts, work with files, projects, research, and memory, and check what Claude gives you before you rely on it.
- [Claude for Work](content/lanes/claude-for-work/lane.md): Turn Claude into a daily work tool with skills, connectors, extensions, plugins, and Office and browser integrations, while keeping review and data handling sound.

## Learning lanes: Build with Claude

- [Building Agents with Claude](content/lanes/building-agents/lane.md): Design, wire, guard, and evaluate production Claude agents, from the tool-use loop to hosted Managed Agents.
- [Claude API Fundamentals](content/lanes/claude-api-fundamentals/lane.md): Go from an API key to a production-ready Claude integration: requests, models, streaming, thinking, files, structured outputs, caching, batches, errors, and cost.
- [Claude Code in Practice](content/lanes/claude-code/lane.md): Configure, extend, and automate Claude Code so long sessions stay safe, focused, and repeatable for a whole team.
- [MCP and Integrations](content/lanes/mcp-and-integrations/lane.md): Design, build, secure, and connect Model Context Protocol servers, and choose when MCP is the right way to give Claude a capability.
- [Prompt Engineering for Claude](content/lanes/prompt-engineering/lane.md): Write prompts for current Claude models that are clear, structured, grounded, and measured with evals, and drop the habits built for older models.

## Learning lanes: Administer Claude

- [Claude Desktop Deployment](content/lanes/desktop-deployment/lane.md): Package, configure, and verify Claude Desktop and Claude Code across macOS and Windows fleets with MDM, Group Policy, and Intune.
- [Enterprise Administration](content/lanes/enterprise-administration/lane.md): Run Claude for Team or Enterprise with confidence: identity, provisioning, governance, data controls, audit, and API organization administration.

## Learning lanes: Partner & industry

- [Industry Solutions](content/lanes/industry-solutions/lane.md): Design Claude solutions for specific functions and regulated industries, from legal workflows to financial services, with the guardrails each one needs.
- [Partner Delivery and Adoption](content/lanes/partner-delivery-adoption/lane.md): Run a Claude deployment for a client from discovery workshop to a governed, measured, self-sustaining operating model.
- [Enterprise Solutioning with Claude](content/lanes/partner-enterprise-solutioning/lane.md): Position, scope, and propose Claude offerings: map customer signals to the right product and plan, run structured discovery, frame value, answer objections with verified facts, and shape a statement of work.
- [Foundation Models for Client Conversations](content/lanes/partner-foundation-models/lane.md): Explain how large language models work, in plain language, so clients make sound decisions about cost, latency, accuracy, and model choice.

## Interactive app and tools

- [Learning app (GitHub Pages)](docs/index.html): Study/Lessons, Practice, timed Exam/Checkpoint, and Flashcards for every track and lane; vanilla JS
- [Plugin marketplace catalog](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): the Anthropic University plugin (study plans, lanes, quizzes, mock exams, flashcards, explainers, client role-play, Quizlet/Anki export, contributor tools) for Claude Code, the Claude desktop app, and Claude chat
- [Learning paths](plugins/anthropic-university/references/learning-paths.md): role → lanes → certification
- [Official blueprints summary](plugins/anthropic-university/references/blueprints.md)
